verdict: Paid spend is small but efficient — $2,167 drove 63 pixel purchases and $11,955 in revenue this period.
diagnosis: The Muslim Subscription Box campaign is carrying the account, but only 94 checkouts started from 237 add-to-carts — checkout drop-off is the leak.

signals.headline: 63 pixel purchases at $2,167 spend
signals.detail: Return on ad spend sits well above the 4.5x food and beverage median. The campaign is working — just under-funded.

signals.headline: 237 add-to-carts, only 94 checkouts
signals.detail: Roughly 60% of shoppers who add to cart never start checkout. Biggest single revenue leak this period.

signals.headline: 438 pixel leads at $4.95 each
signals.detail: Lead cost is very healthy. Email capture is functioning — the question is whether follow-up flows convert them.

signals.headline: 6,654 followers, 357 profile visits
signals.detail: Organic Instagram is essentially dormant. Only 37 average engagements per post over 28 days.

signals.headline: 272 reviews, 5-star latest rating
signals.detail: Local reputation is a real asset. Two new reviews this period at 5 stars — under-leveraged in ads.

recommendations.title: Fix the add-to-cart to checkout drop-off
recommendations.detail: Only 40% of add-to-carts start checkout. Test guest checkout, shipping cost visibility earlier, and an abandoned-cart email within one hour.

recommendations.title: Scale the Muslim Subscription Box campaign carefully
recommendations.detail: Cost per purchase and revenue return both beat category norms. Consider a 25–40% budget lift with fresh creative every 11 days to avoid fatigue.

recommendations.title: Turn 272 reviews into ad creative
recommendations.detail: Local reputation is strong but invisible in paid ads. Test review screenshots and 5-star quotes as static and video hooks.
